name: Reelist
description: A Rails portfolio app for building personal movie collections, importing films from TMDB, choosing covers from Pexels and getting movie-night recommendations.

APP_HOST.description: Production host without protocol, for example reelist-demo.herokuapp.com.

RAILS_MASTER_KEY.description: Rails master key, if credentials are used.

TMDB_API_TOKEN.description: TMDB API Read Access Token used for movie search and recommendations.

PEXELS_API_KEY.description: Pexels API key used for collection covers and the home hero video.

DEMO_USER_EMAIL.description: Optional email for the seeded demo account.

DEMO_USER_PASSWORD.description: Optional password for the seeded demo account.
